notes: REQUIRES PLAYWRIGHT/SELENIUM: The listings page uses JavaScript to dynamically load business listings into an empty div (class 'et_pb_code_2'). The page is built with Divi theme and appears to embed listings via a third-party widget or custom JavaScript application. Static HTML scraping returns no listing data. To scrape this site, you need: 1) Use Playwright or Selenium to render JavaScript, 2) Wait for listings to load in the DOM, 3) Identify the dynamically-generated selectors after JS execution. Alternative approach: Check if the widget makes API calls that could be intercepted and scraped directly. The site has been in business since 1936 according to their branding.
